CRU-087 Home hub  ·  CRU-088 golden visual system

Light-first, warm. The page is #FAF6EF, not the cool #F1F2F5 you have now — that cool grey is a large part of why gold has never looked right in this app.

Gold is subtle by rule, not by taste. It appears in exactly three places: the banner wash, the Log chip, and the active tab. The tick is teal, because gold marks what needs doing, not what is done. Type is Gabarito over Inter — a warm geometric, not an editorial serif.

Settled and built in: loop first, greeting replaces Today, the popover is gone, Other is a ghost row inside the accordion, tips are contextual, four tiles.

There is no colour per pet — avatars do that job. The photos are stand-ins. Slide the accent chip on any artboard to move the gold everywhere at once.

HOME — the whole scroll, not one screen.
The dashed line marks where the first screen ends. Both pets and the start of the tiles sit above it, so the log loop never needs a scroll. That was the 6 August decision and it still holds.

POSTS — gold is almost banned here.
No primary action, no state, so nothing earns it except the compose button and the tab. Photos on white, warm page as the divider band. Airbnb's move, and the reason your dark versions felt wrong.

THE BANNER — the one piece of motion worth building now.
Four states, one surface. The sun breathes on a 7s loop and stops under reduced-motion. Night is the only dark surface in light mode, which is what makes it land.

TOKENS — what goes into theme.ts.
Read the contrast note. Two new tokens the current theme has no room for: primaryText, because gold cannot carry text on white, and success, because the tick can no longer be primary.

No identity palette. A pet is its photo.
